definitions.documentation: Event output contract for Fleet Git revision or readiness changed. Reads /apis/fleet.cattle.io/v1alpha1/namespaces/{namespace}/gitrepos?limit=500. First successful poll baselines the current finite snapshot. Later polls emit created/updated minimized resources; absent resources never emit deletion. Short-lived intermediate states and resources removed between polls can be missed. Each poll makes one HTTPS read, fails on continuation/full pages, caps the response at 2 MiB and the checkpoint at 110,000 bytes. Narrow scope rather than silently dropping events. Name-filter changes reset the baseline. Checkpoints commit before downstream completion. Downstream failure does not restore them. Resource reappearance after absence emits created; no exactly-once guarantee. Provider source: https://fleet.rancher.io/reference/ref-crds
